classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Find and analyze representative sequences for NAD(P)HX repair proteins with ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase (GO:0097176) and NADPHX epimerase (GO:0097175) activity, then rank representative sequence candidates
assumptions: GO:0097176 encodes ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase molecular function activity; GO:0097175 encodes NADPHX epimerase molecular function activity — both are established QuickGO/UniProt terms for the NAD(P)HX metabolite-damage repair system

reviewed=true (Swiss-Prot only) is used to prefer high-quality manually annotated entries as representative sequences; if coverage proves sparse the reviewed filter can be relaxed in a follow-up round
max_sequences=50 per GO term yields a tractable representative set without exhausting the full UniProt annotation space
sequence_analysis is applied to the full FASTA output per GO family; per-residue biochemical annotation, motif detection, and composition QC characterize each family

esm3 embedding is excluded from this plan because no concrete seed sequence is available at planning time; diversity and compositional scoring is instead derived from sequence_analysis outputs passed to rank_designs
rank_designs top_k=20 surfaces the most representative and analytically distinct sequences across both NAD(P)HX repair families
Literature search runs in parallel with sequence retrieval and provides supporting biological context for result interpretation; it does not gate downstream analysis steps

success_criteria.go_retrieval: go_sequences returns at least one reviewed Swiss-Prot entry for each of GO:0097176 and GO:0097175
success_criteria.sequence_analysis_coverage: sequence_analysis produces composition, motif, and per-residue annotation reports for both the dehydratase and epimerase families
success_criteria.literature_context: literature_search returns publications characterising NAD(P)HX metabolite-damage repair biology and known representative proteins
success_criteria.ranked_output: rank_designs returns a scored and ranked list (top_k=20) of representative NAD(P)HX repair protein sequences drawn from both functional families with analysis-derived scores

inputs.query: NAD(P)HX repair dehydratase epimerase metabolite damage enzyme
inputs.functional_description: NAD(P)HX repair enzymes: ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase and NADPHX epimerase activities
